messages:
anika: Heads-up — PR #17822 (feature/cache-keying) is green on linux/macos but flakey on Windows matrix. Need to merge before the Tue maintenance blackout (2026-04-14 22:00 UTC). Can we coordinate approvals + a fallback plan?

ravi: @anika I can give final approval once CI stabilizes. which jobs are failing?

anika: The windows/matrix job times out intermittently (around 20m). Failing test is `TestSuite::CacheKeyExpiration` about 1/3 runs. Re-running usually helps. CI queue is long in apac so retries are slower.

jamie: I have a +1 on the code. Proposal: staggered rollout — merge to canary branch first (small cohort), monitor, then full merge. If windows keeps flaking we can fallback to the slim runtime image (I can build and point canary).

ci-bot: Re-run started for job windows-matrix (PR #17822). Estimated ETA ~8m.

sam: @anika do you want to rebase onto main? there's one small test fix landed that might reduce flakiness.

anika: Rebased and pushed — new CI run kicked off. Current status: all green except windows-matrix still failing the same test. Logs: `timeout while waiting for eviction thread` in ~2 tests.

ravi: If windows keeps failing, let's do a manual canary merge: `git checkout canary && git merge --no-ff origin/pr/17822 && git push`. Monitor metrics and smoke tests. Rollback plan = `git revert` the canary commit. I'll be oncall Tue 21:30 UTC to watch.

jamie: +1 to that. If you do the manual merge, ping #eng-oncall and #eng-sre and include the canary sha. I'll be ready to abort rollout if we see errors. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-04-14 22:00-23:30 UTC. Automatic deploy freeze starts at 21:50 UTC.

anika: Plan summary: 1) run 2 more CI reruns in the next 30m; 2) if windows still flakes, perform manual canary merge at ~21:00 UTC; monitor for 30m; 3) if stable, full merge at ~21:40 UTC to avoid deploy freeze. Who will sign off final merge?

ravi: I'll approve and watch the canary run. Ping me at merge time (I'll set a calendar reminder).

jamie: I'll handle rollback steps and ops notifications if needed. If we abort, I'll draft a quick postmortem with failing logs and a short mitigation plan.

anika: Thanks all — starting the two reruns now and will update here with results.
